_metadata.description: Server-owned async jobs and a bounded derived-artifact budget.

requirements.title: Jobs survive client disconnect
requirements.description: Long operations are server-owned jobs with durable status and progress; cancelling a client does not abort the run, and every job ends in success or an explicit, recoverable failure classification.

validation.notes: Durable job lifecycle is covered by the shipped job manager tests

requirements.title: Derived artifacts are bounded and evictable
requirements.description: Stems and other derived audio are produced on demand and held under a declared storage budget with least-recently-used eviction. There is no operation that materialises stems for an entire library, because doing so would exceed available disk by roughly an order of magnitude.

validation.notes: Storage budgets and eviction behavior are covered by the shipped storage tests

requirements.title: Outputs flow through the shared blob seam
requirements.description: Generated and derived audio is written through the shared api-core BlobStore seam with ownership metadata, rather than to ad-hoc filesystem paths.

validation.notes: Blob persistence and ownership behavior are covered by the shipped storage tests
